title: DeskState
description: Rolling state schema for individual watch desks to prevent full-history replay

desk.description: Watch desk identifier (e.g. kuwait, iran, hormuz, qatar, gcc, levant, red_sea)

last_run_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last executed run

open_incidents.description: List of active incident IDs currently tracked by this desk

silence_streak.description: Number of consecutive quiet runs with zero new material developments

last_alert_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent ALERT-level event, or null if none

since_cursor.description: Pagination/snowflake cursor for incremental X polling

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when state file was saved
